verdict.rationale: Bolna documents multi-step workflows that combine calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, all driven through the API. It also offers per-agent webhooks that push call data to a CRM after every call, which gives some event-driven automation. However, nothing in the evidence describes a user-defined rule or condition engine (if event X then action Y), so this is only partial support. Missing for 10: explicit event-triggered rule/condition definitions, documentation of which events can trigger workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
